content: Previous work pointed out some specific roles played by different heads in the softmax Transformer model BIBREF33, BIBREF5, BIBREF9. Identifying the specialization of a head can be done by observing the type of tokens or sequences that the head often assigns most of its attention weight; this is facilitated by sparsity.
